title: APP scam facts Q1 2026
discussion_signal: The regulator's public post circulates the Q1 2026 reimbursement release as a consumer-protection result, emphasizing nearly £250 million reimbursed over the prior 12 months. This is an official communication and agenda-setting signal about remedy visibility, not independent evidence of individual adequacy or trust restoration.
linked_research_question: How does public communication of aggregate reimbursement change the visibility and legitimacy of a payment remedy when recipient-level recovery remains unobserved?
limits: The post is an official summary rather than a recipient-level account
It does not expose individual reimbursement, residual loss, or later provider behavior
Public circulation cannot establish consumer trust, switching, or durable financial recovery
